title: SMS: Configure a Provider and Send a Test Message | Orchard Core
description:
A site that sends text messages needs a provider to deliver them, and a way to check that the provider works before anything depends on it.

The SMS feature of Orchard Core adds a settings page where you choose the default provider and set up Twilio, and a test page that sends a message through the provider you pick. Azure Communication Services has a feature of its own that adds a tab to the same settings page.

In this video:
• How SMS providers and the default provider work
• Enabling the SMS feature
• Choosing the default provider
• Sending a test message
• Configuring Twilio
• Configuring Azure Communication Services
